title: Jewel beetles mating with stubby beer bottles

tellings.quote: So they they some guys, you know, in Australia drink them, throw them out into outback and drive off. And the male jewel beetles flock to these bottles.

plain: A scientist named Don Hoffman, who studies how we perceive the world, tells of men in Australia who drink short brown beer bottles called stubbies, toss them into the outback and drive off. According to Hoffman, male jewel beetles flock to these bottles and try to mate with them, mistaking them for females. He uses it to show how a brain built by evolution can badly misread what is in front of it.
